cause_quote: It pulled the composer up over the transcript with `margin-top: calc(-1 * var(--chat-composer-overlap, 0px))` and relied on `--chat-thread-padding-bottom: calc(6px + var(--chat-composer-overlap, 0px))` for clearance, padding that Firefox drops from the desktop transcript's grid scroll range.
user_saw: In Firefox on desktop, the last reply's footer controls (such as Copy) sat hidden behind the chat composer at the bottom of the transcript.
summary: Moves the desktop Details reservation from a CSS grid on the transcript scroll container to a width-reduced .chat-thread-content wrapper, so Firefox includes the bottom padding in the scroll range, and updates geometry code for the extra wrapper.
reasoning: The desktop scroll container became `display: grid` in #179059 (2026-10-21), and the fix says Firefox leaves trailing grid padding out of the scroll range. That cost only 6px until #195508 (2026-11-09) made the composer overlap the transcript and moved the last turn's clearance into that padding, so Firefox reply footers were first covered then. I read both diffs; confidence is medium because I did not reproduce the Firefox padding behavior myself, and #179059's grid is the precondition rather than the visible break.
